description: Flat metadata schema for individual buffer-solution records used in protein crystallography crystallization experiments.

buffer_record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this buffer-solution record within the dataset or laboratory inventory.

buffer_name.descr: Common name or label of the buffer solution, e.g., Tris-HCl, HEPES, sodium acetate.

buffer_composition.descr: Text description of the buffer composition, including all major solutes and their amounts or molarities, e.g., 50 mM Tris-HCl, 150 mM NaCl.

buffer_pH.descr: Measured or adjusted pH of the buffer solution at the time of preparation or use; use standard pH scale units.

buffer_concentration.descr: Primary concentration of the buffer component or total buffering species, with units described in the accompanying text or laboratory convention, e.g., 50 mM.

buffer_concentration_unit.descr: Unit for buffer concentration, e.g., mM, M, % w/v, % v/v.

buffer_batch_number.descr: Batch, lot, or preparation number assigned to this buffer solution.

buffer_supplier.descr: Name of the supplier, vendor, or manufacturer of the buffer or its chemical components.

buffer_catalog_number.descr: Supplier catalog number or part number for the buffer or key ingredient.

buffer_prepared_in_house.descr: Indicates whether the buffer was prepared in-house rather than purchased as a ready-made solution.

buffer_preparation_date.descr: Date the buffer solution was prepared, formatted as a calendar date.

buffer_storage_conditions.descr: Text description of storage conditions, e.g., 4 C, room temperature, protected from light, frozen at -20 C.

buffer_sterility_or_filtration.descr: Text description of filtration or sterility treatment, e.g., 0.22 µm filtered, sterile-filtered, autoclaved.

buffer_aliases.descr: Alternative names, synonyms, or internal labels used for the same buffer solution.

buffer_notes.descr: Free-text notes on buffer quality, observed precipitation, stability issues, or other relevant preparation details.
